Jwt.// Key: Story 4.1 (NFR6): NO signing key here. Dev value lives in appsettings.Development.json; every other environment must supply Jwt__Key via env/user-secrets (32+ random bytes) or the BFF refuses to boot.

Anon.// SigningKey: HMAC key for the durable anon cookie — SEPARATE from Jwt:Key, STABLE across restarts. Dev value in appsettings.Development.json; prod via Anon__SigningKey (32+ bytes). Boot-validated.

Storage.// LocalRoot: Resolves relative to dotnet run's working dir (the project dir, components/bff/src/Spectr.Bff). Four ../ reaches the repo root.
